description.zh: 模拟 Codex 跨会话记忆系统的完整流程：Session 启动触发后台任务 → Stage1 per-thread 争抢与提取（raw_memory + rollout_summary） → Phase2 全局整合（LLM 增量整合 → ~/.codex/memories/） → 新会话注入 + 污染检测（web_search → memory_mode='polluted' → re-consolidation）。
description.en: Simulate Codex cross-session memory system: Session start triggers background task → Stage1 per-thread job claiming and extraction (raw_memory + rollout_summary) → Phase2 global consolidation (LLM incremental merge → ~/.codex/memories/) → injection into new session + pollution detection (web_search → memory_mode='polluted' → re-consolidation).

annotation.zh: session.rs:836 — 新会话启动后，memories::start_memories_startup_task() 在后台启动 Stage1 + Phase2 任务。Feature::Sqlite 和 Feature::MemoryTool 必须启用。
annotation.en: session.rs:836 — After new session starts, memories::start_memories_startup_task() launches Stage1 + Phase2 tasks in background. Feature::Sqlite and Feature::MemoryTool must be enabled.

annotation.zh: claim_stage1_jobs_for_startup() 通过 SQL 查询找到 memory_mode='enabled' 且 Stage1 输出已过期的线程。同时排除当前会话自身。
annotation.en: claim_stage1_jobs_for_startup() finds threads with memory_mode='enabled' whose Stage1 output is stale. Excludes the current session itself.

annotation.zh: try_claim_stage1_job() 使用 SQLite 事务实现分布式 job claiming。lease 机制（lease_until）防止 worker 崩溃后 job 永久卡死。
annotation.en: try_claim_stage1_job() implements distributed job claiming via SQLite transaction. lease_until prevents jobs from getting stuck if a worker crashes.

annotation.zh: Stage1 成功后，raw_memory 和 rollout_summary 写入 stage1_outputs 表，并自动调用 enqueue_global_consolidation() 将 Phase2 job 设为 pending。
annotation.en: After Stage1 success, raw_memory and rollout_summary are written to stage1_outputs table, and enqueue_global_consolidation() automatically sets Phase2 job to pending.

annotation.zh: Phase2 争抢全局单例 job。input_watermark 确保只有在有新 Stage1 输出时才执行 LLM 调用，避免无谓开销。
annotation.en: Phase2 claims the global singleton job. input_watermark ensures LLM is only called when there are new Stage1 outputs, avoiding unnecessary overhead.

steps.content:
// Phase2 LLM 整合完成后写入文件系统

// ~/.codex/memories/raw_memories.md (合并所有 raw_memory):
"""
## thread-A (main, /workspace/auth, 2025-01-24)
- 在 main 分支重构了认证模块
- 修复了 OAuth 回调路径 bug  
- 使用 argon2 替换了 bcrypt
"""

// ~/.codex/memories/rollout_summaries/thread-A-rollout-thread-a.md:
"""
git_branch: main
cwd: /workspace/auth

完成了认证模块重构。主要改动：
...
"""

// 标记 Phase2 成功
mark_global_phase2_job_succeeded(
  &ownership_token,
  completed_watermark,
  &selected_outputs, // 标记 selected_for_phase2=1
).await?;

annotation.zh: Phase2 整合输出写入 ~/.codex/memories/ 目录。mark_global_phase2_job_succeeded() 同时更新 selected_for_phase2=1，记录本次 baseline，用于下次 Phase2 的增量 diff。
annotation.en: Phase2 consolidation writes to ~/.codex/memories/. mark_global_phase2_job_succeeded() also sets selected_for_phase2=1 to record the baseline for incremental diff in next Phase2 run.

steps.content: 请帮我搜索一下 OAuth2 的最新规范变更

annotation.zh: 用户请求触发了 web_search 工具调用——这将导致当前线程的记忆被标记为 polluted
annotation.en: User request triggers a web_search tool call — this will cause the current thread's memory to be marked as polluted

annotation.zh: web_search 触发 mark_thread_memory_mode_polluted()。若该线程曾入选 Phase2 baseline，系统自动触发 re-consolidation，下次 Phase2 时将其从 selected 移入 removed。
annotation.en: web_search triggers mark_thread_memory_mode_polluted(). If the thread was in Phase2 baseline, system automatically triggers re-consolidation to move it from selected to removed in next Phase2.
